title: 第28章 陆林爱练功，任忠武中箭
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
梁心兰从小没有走出过白杨镇。

    她也没见过大海。

    但是，这一刻，她感觉自己就是大海上的一叶孤舟，在狂风暴雨，海浪滔天之中，起起伏伏。

    随着一种发自灵魂深处的颤栗和舒爽。

    梁心兰如同一块软泥，躺在床上。

    胸口不停起伏着，脸颊如同抹了最名贵的胭脂。

    发丝贴在沁了汗水的脸上，平添了一抹娇柔。

    “嫂嫂，你真美。”

    陆林轻声赞美，温热的气息打在梁心兰的耳畔。

    梁心兰身子抖了一下，连忙道：“小叔，我真的不行了。”

    “安心，我去弄早饭。”

    “还是我来吧。”

    梁心兰挣扎着要起来，却被陆林按在被窝里。

    “你辛苦了一夜，多休息休息，注意养伤。”

    养伤？

    梁心兰的脸，红的要滴下水来。

    她低头，恰好看到床单上的那一抹殷红。

    陆林去厨房，淘米，蒸饭。

    锅里还有昨夜剩下的鹿肉，陆林加热一番，便端来与嫂嫂吃饭。

    饭毕。

    陆林这才有时间查看自己的内力。

    融入了水之气息的内力，也多了一丝清凉，柔顺。

    绵绵不绝。

    生生不息。

    内力游走全身上下，让陆林那因为吃了鹿肉而燥热的身体，变得清爽。

    “只是，该怎么锻骨呢。”

    这就是没有师承的坏处，陆林每一次遇到武学难题，都只能自己思索，连个能给他解惑的人也没有。

    陆林想控制内力去淬炼骨骼。

    只是内力一进入骨头，立马融入其中，消失不见。

    “这算是淬炼吗？”

    陆林也不知道。

    既然研究不出淬骨的办法，陆林只能修行其他武技。

    箭术，是陆林的立身之基。

    随着悟性暴涨，陆林每一箭射出，都会增加数点经验。

    少则三点五点，多则十点八点。

    一天下来，箭术经验竟然提升了接近一千五百点。

    这么计算下来，要不了几天，就能提升到下一个境界。

    年关越来越近。

    南山村也从之前的悲伤中走出，家家户户热闹起来。

    时不时有人来陆林家里串门，送些礼物。

    或是家里养的老母鸡，或是山上找到的山珍，药材。

    陆林也会回赠些米面。

    山民淳朴，以物易物还好，大家都不觉得亏欠。

    若是你回赠金银，那便是不妥。
content_en:
Liang Xinlan had never left Baiyang Town since she was a child.

She hasn't seen the sea either.

However, at this moment, she felt like a lonely boat on the sea, rising and falling amidst the violent storms and huge waves.

With a shiver and relief from the depths of the soul.

Liang Xinlan was lying on the bed like a piece of soft mud.

His chest kept rising and falling, and his cheeks seemed to have been smeared with the most precious rouge.

The hair stuck to the sweaty face, adding a touch of tenderness.

"Sister-in-law, you are so beautiful."

Lu Lin praised softly, and his warm breath hit Liang Xinlan's ears.

Liang Xinlan trembled and said quickly: "Uncle, I really can't do it anymore."

"Don't worry, I'll make breakfast."

"I'll do it."

Liang Xinlan struggled to get up, but was pinned down by Lu Lin.

"You've worked hard all night. Get more rest and pay attention to your injuries."

Recuperate?

Liang Xinlan's face was so red that it was about to drip.

She lowered her head and happened to see the bright red on the sheets.

Lu Lin went to the kitchen to wash and steam rice.

There was leftover venison in the pot from last night. Lu Lin heated it up and brought it to his sister-in-law for dinner.

Dinner is over.

Only then did Lu Lin have time to check his internal strength.

The inner energy that has been blended with the breath of water also has a touch of coolness and suppleness.

It goes on and on.

Life goes on and on.

Internal energy traveled throughout his body, refreshing Lu Lin's body that was hot from eating venison.

"It's just, how to strengthen the bones."

This is the disadvantage of not having a mentor. Every time Lu Lin encounters a martial arts problem, he can only think about it by himself, and there is no one who can help him solve his doubts.

Lu Lin wanted to control his internal energy to temper his bones.

But as soon as the internal force enters the bone, it immediately blends into it and disappears.

"Is this considered tempering?"

Lu Lin didn't know either.

Since he couldn't find a way to temper bones, Lu Lin could only practice other martial arts.

Archery is the foundation of Lu Lin's career.

As his understanding skyrocketed, every time Lu Lin shot an arrow, he would gain several points of experience.

The minimum is 3.5 points, and the maximum is 10.8 points.

At the end of the day, my archery experience increased by nearly 1,500 points.

Based on this calculation, it will take only a few days to reach the next level.

The new year is getting closer.

Nanshan Village has also recovered from the previous sadness, and every household is lively.

From time to time, people would come to Lu Lin's house to give him gifts.

Or old hens raised at home, or delicacies and medicinal materials found in the mountains.

Lu Lin will also give some rice noodles in return.

The mountain people are simple and honest, so bartering is fine, and no one feels indebted.

If you give gold or silver in return, that would be inappropriate.
